title: The Small Silence
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Sebastian Okonkwo, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
